blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Labor group Trade Union Congress of the Philippines (TUCP) has called for a congressional investigation into AirAsia Philippines’ confirmed retrenchment of around 90 pilots, announced on the same day a labor union secured approval to hold a certification election. The affected captains and first officers were informed on Nov. 25 that their employment would be terminated effective Dec. 31, according to TUCP president Carlos Miguel Oñate. The announcement coincided with the approval of the petition for a certification election filed by the AirAsia Philippines Pilots Union (APPU), affiliated with the Associated Professional Supervisory Office and Technical Employees Union.
